payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the datasets used in the study, including the NRC Hashtag Emotion Lexicon and various word embeddings derived from Twitter data.

claims.text: The dataset used includes the NRC Hashtag Emotion Lexicon, which contains emotion word associations computed from an emotion-labeled Twitter corpus.
The study also utilized word embeddings created from a Twitter dataset, including GloVe embeddings trained on 2 billion tweets.
The dev dataset BIBREF19 was small, leading to the merging of train and dev sets for cross-validation.
